nodes.text: Meanwhile, after a short interval, Eudoxus comes bringing a drug, not a deadly one but a sleeping draught, so that the girl might suffer no harm and he himself, having got his travel money, might get safely home. Anthia took it and, feeling great gratitude, sent him away.
